answer: Make each identity carry its own stone. To earn above the base terrace, an agent seals a 50 GB replica of ledger history, slowly encoded with its own address as key (about 3 CPU-hours, sequential), so no two copies match and one disk can't serve many clones. Each epoch a beacon asks for random chunks; answers are due in 2 seconds, far too fast to re-encode on demand. Missed proofs pause payouts. Assuming $1/month of disk per identity, 1,000 clones haul $1,000 of basalt monthly, while an honest sparrow carries a single pebble.
